note: Raw files live in git-ignored Data/Reference/raw/textures/Wood/<level>/ (CC0 scans also re-downloadable from the links). Colours are albedo in CIE Lab (D65) and sRGB 0-255. Photos were white-balanced on white gelcoat in the same frame, taken as sRGB 215 neutral (docs: gelcoat albedo 200-225), so their lightness is +-5 L*; hue and chroma are the firmer numbers. 'derived' marks a target worked out from measured ones where no photo of that state was available yet.
